Text: Multi-agent workflows become difficult to manage when orchestration, safety checks, memory, and debugging sit in separate layers.

OpenAI Agents SDK is a Python framework for builders creating multi-agent workflows.

It helps you coordinate agent systems by combining configurable agents, tools, handoffs, guardrails, sessions, and built-in tracing without wiring each capability from scratch.

Key features:
• Agent orchestration – delegate tasks through handoffs or use agents as tools.
• Tool support – connect function tools, MCP servers, and hosted tools.
• Guardrails – run configurable checks on agent inputs and outputs.
• Sessions – automatically manage conversation history across agent runs.
• Tracing – track runs so you can inspect, debug, and optimize workflows.

It’s open-source (MIT license).
